description: The owner's move on an application to one of the user's projects: shortlist, accept or decline, with an optional message posted in the thread afterwards. The applicant is e-mailed, exactly as when the owner decides in the Studio. A decision is final (accepted and declined applications cannot be moved again).

action.description: shortlist (a submitted application), accept or decline (a submitted or shortlisted one).

application_id.description: The application's id (from list_project_applications, list_my_applications or apply_to_role).

message.description: An optional message to the applicant, posted in the thread after the decision.

name: respond_to_application
title: Respond to an applicant
